skills.skill_desc:
Roger can freely switch between human and wolf forms.
In human form, Roger's attack deals extra damage equal to 4% of the target's <font color="26e407">current <1005></font>. In wolf form, his attack deals extra damage equal to 4% of the target's [lost C6<1997>].
Extra damage against creeps is capped at 60.

Roger fires two quick shots in the target direction, dealing a total of 250<font color="fba51f"> (+125% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the enemy hit.
The first shot is a hunter net that slows the enemy by 80% for 1.5s.
The second is a bullet that reduces the enemy's <font color="fba51f"><1060></font> by 10 for 5s.
Roger gains 20% Movement Speed and 20% Attack Speed for 2.5s.

Roger lunges in the target direction and turns into wolf form, dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit and slowing them by 90% for 0.8s.

<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: In wolf form, Roger gains 20 <font color="26e407"><1999></font> and 25 Movement Speed.
